heading: Emptydir
cmds: kubectl -n s13 apply -f emptydir/pod.yaml; kubectl -n s13 wait --for=condition=Ready pod/emptydir-demo --timeo
kubectl -n s13 exec emptydir-demo -- sh -c "echo hello-emptydir > /data/file.txt; cat /data/file.txt"
echo "--- kill the container process (container restarts, Pod stays):"; kubectl -n s13 exec emptydir-demo -- s
echo "--- delete and recreate the Pod:"; kubectl -n s13 delete pod emptydir-demo --wait=true; kubectl -n s13 a

heading: Hostpath
cmds: kubectl -n s13 apply -f hostpath/pod.yaml; kubectl -n s13 wait --for=condition=Ready pod/hostpath-demo --timeo
echo "--- the file is on the NODE at /tmp/hostpath-data:"; minikube ssh -- "ls -l /tmp/hostpath-data; cat /tmp
kubectl -n s13 delete pod hostpath-demo --wait=true; kubectl -n s13 apply -f hostpath/pod.yaml; kubectl -n s13

heading: Pv-Pvc
cmds: kubectl apply -f persistent-volume/pv.yaml; kubectl get pv hw-student-pv
kubectl -n s13 apply -f persistent-volume/pvc.yaml; sleep 3; kubectl -n s13 get pvc hw-student-pvc; kubectl ge
kubectl -n s13 apply -f persistent-volume/pod.yaml; kubectl -n s13 wait --for=condition=Ready pod/storage-demo
echo "--- delete the Pod, create it again:"; kubectl -n s13 delete pod storage-demo --wait=true; kubectl -n s1

heading: Pv-Pvc
cmds: kubectl -n s13 describe pvc hw-student-pvc | sed -n "1,14p"
kubectl -n s13 delete pod storage-demo --wait=true; kubectl -n s13 delete pvc hw-student-pvc; sleep 3; echo "-

kubectl -n s13 apply -f dynamic-storageclass/pvc.yaml; sleep 3; kubectl -n s13 get pvc dynamic-pvc; kubectl -n
kubectl -n s13 apply -f dynamic-storageclass/pod.yaml; kubectl -n s13 wait --for=condition=Ready pod/dynamic-p
